install: set -euo pipefail; touch "$HOME/.bashrc"; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; VENV_BIN="$(pwd)/backend/.venv/bin"; grep -qxF "export PATH=\"$VENV_BIN:\$PATH\"" "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo "export PATH=\"$VENV_BIN:\$PATH\"" >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; if ! command -v ffmpeg >/dev/null || ! command -v pandoc >/dev/null || ! command -v pdftoppm >/dev/null || ! command -v convert >/dev/null; then sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -qq && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends ffmpeg pandoc poppler-utils imagemagick; fi; uv sync --project backend; pnpm --dir frontend install; uv run --project backend lazarus skills sync
